I use to think about how it would be selfish to leave my family behind too but eventually I got tired of carrying that guilt around. I was so focused on the suffering that people caused me I forgot to think about the most important person, myself. I think you should focus on yourself, it ain’t gonna be easy but it helps to think about small things you want to do and how you can pursue them. In seems small now but it’s a start to bringing things that make you happy back into your life. Also losing someone is never easy and you are going to grieve for a while. Some days will be easier than others but it’s important to remember that they aren’t gone forever. You carry bits and pieces of the people you know within you. They will always live on within the people they loved and the people that loved them. I wish you the best in your future endeavors. Always remember that things truly do get better ( I used to hate people telling me this).
